cards.card_text: Buttercup would love this one: terebinth and oak trees, felled.
cards.verse_text: As the terebinth and oak leave stumps when felled, so the holy seed will be a stump in the land.”

cards.card_text: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar and terebinth trees.
cards.verse_text: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth, because their shade is pleasant.
